name: Voice Feedback – Voice Recorder for Audio Feedback
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Voice Feedback – #1 Voice Recorder Plugin for Collecting Audio Feedback in WordPress

Voice Feedback | Pricing | Support

Voice Feedback makes it easy for visitors to leave audio feedback on your WordPress site. They can simply record their voice—no login or personal details needed.

The plugin adds a voice recording field to your site using a floating drawer, block, or shortcode. All voice messages are saved in the admin panel, where you can listen to them, manage, or delete as needed.

Perfect for blogs, portfolios, education sites, product pages, or any website where collecting user feedback matters.

Key Features

  • Voice Recording Field for Users – Visitors can record their voice directly from your site without needing an account.

  • Review Before Submit – Users can play back their message before sending and re-record if needed.

  • Voice Library (Admin Panel) – All submitted voice messages are stored in an organized dashboard.

  • Playback and Management – Admins can listen to each voice recording and delete them if necessary.

  • Customizable UI – Modify drawer appearance with options for typography, padding, border radius, and more.

  • Multiple Display Options – Automatically shows a voice feedback drawer site-wide, or add specific instances via block or shortcode.

  • Lightweight and Secure – No personal data is collected; focused only on voice-based user interaction.

Embed Options

  • Global Drawer Button – Appears on all pages by default. Easily toggle on/off via the settings page.

  • Gutenberg Block – Add a “Voice Feedback” block to any post or page.

  • Shortcode Support – Generate shortcodes for custom placement. Create and manage them from the Voice Library menu.

Settings & Controls

  • Drawer visibility toggle

  • Drawer button customization (text, padding, typography)

  • Responsive design for mobile and desktop

  • Easy-to-use admin interface

Ideal Use Cases

  • Collect user voice feedback and suggestions

  • Add audio comment or voice comments capability to blog posts

  • Enable clients to send quick voice updates

  • Get spoken UX feedback or testimonials

  • Use as a voice feedback generator tool

  • Receive spoken suggestions or bug reports

Upcoming Features

  • Contact form integration with voice field
  • Integration with project/task management tools

  • PDF Poster – A fully-featured PDF Viewer Plugin for WordPress.

  • StreamCast – A fully-featured Radio Player Plugin for WordPress.

  • 3D Viewer – Display interactive 3D models on the webs.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install from the Plugins directory.

  2. Activate the plugin.

  3. A voice feedback drawer will appear automatically on your site.

  4. Visit Voice Library → Settings to customize or disable the drawer.

  5. Use the Gutenberg block or generate a shortcode from the admin to place on specific pages.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin collect personal data?

No. It only records the voice message. No name, email, or contact information is collected.

Where can I access submitted recordings?

All voice recordings are stored in the Voice Library admin menu, where you can play or delete them.

Can I turn off the floating voice drawer?

Yes. Go to Voice Library → Settings and disable the drawer with a single toggle.

How do I add the voice feedback to a specific post or page?

Use the Voice Feedback block in Gutenberg or copy the shortcode from Voice Library → Voice Feedbacks.

Is it compatible with all WordPress themes?

Yes. It works with all modern, well-coded themes.
